name: 200. Perplexity decisions (perplexity-decisions)
description:
The perplexity provider serves its decider models (pplx-decider-*) natively on POST {base}/v1/decisions, in Typesafe's systemone shape. Perplexity's body carries no id, so Bifrost takes it from the x-request-id response header. An input with images is sent as plain-string text items and {"type":"image_url"} image items in their original order. With convert_decision_to_responses on, a decider name on Perplexity is still served natively rather than emulated. Perplexity's own validation (remote image URLs) comes back as its 400.

The image case sends a solid red square and asserts the decider reads it as mostly red, which a text-only answer does not.
